author: Retro Game Corps
description:
Valve sure is taking their time with the Steam Machine, so let's try to make our own using three different PC configurationss.

PCs used in this video:
GMKtec K12: https://tidd.ly/4vQhSkf
AtomMan G7 PT: https://www.minisforum.com/products/atomman-g7-pt
Playnix: https://playnix.io/

Linux OS options:
Bazzite: https://bazzite.gg/
CachyOS: https://cachyos.org/

The PCs demoed in this video were sent to me by their manufacturers.  All opinions are my own, they did not see this video ahead of time, and no money was exchanged in any way.
